journey.title: Move a finding to a verified resolution
journey.purpose: A maintainer opens the finding that needs attention, follows its evidence to the affected asset, and resolves it without losing the finding context.

steps.intent: Identify the finding with the highest blast radius.
Inspect the affected asset, evidence and versions.
Return to the queue with the resolution evidence attached.

claims.statement: The selected finding, its evidence and its affected asset remain identifiable when the maintainer moves between Review and the asset.
claims.rationale: The Review page and its projection are drafts; this claim records the intended cross-page behavior without pretending it is proven.
